content: Hello! This is Ms. Becker from Greenwood Academy's finance office. How can I assist you regarding your tuition or payment status today?
Hi Ms. Becker, I just wanted to confirm that my daughter's tuition payment went through. I used Zelle yesterday and included her student ID.
Thank you for reaching out. Can you please provide your daughter's full name and student ID so I can quickly locate the transaction in our records?
Sure, her name is Olivia Tran and her student ID is 874315. I sent $2,400 for the spring semester.

Perfect, I see the payment received via Zelle from your account ending in 2104 on June 6th. The transaction reference was ZEL-TRX-983221. The amount of $2,400 has been credited to Olivia Tran, ID 874315.
Great, does that cover everything for spring? I want to make sure nothing is pending.

Yes, your payment settles the full tuition for the Spring 2024 term. No outstanding balance remains on Olivia's account. We've sent a confirmation to your email, ltran.family@gmail.com, for your records.
Thanks for confirming. Will Olivia need to show any proof on the first day?

No additional proof is needed, our system marks her as paid in full under ID 874315. If anything urgent arises, we'll call the number we have on file ending in 9923. Otherwise, she's all set for classes starting June 12th!
